description: Connect to an MCP server (stdio command or Streamable HTTP URL), read its current tools/list response, and store it as the trusted baseline for future drift checks. Call this once, right after you've reviewed and approved a server's tools.

command.description: Command to spawn for a stdio MCP server (e.g. "npx")

cwd.description: Working directory for the spawned process

env.description: Extra environment variables for the spawned process

label.description: Stable identifier for this server, used to look up its baseline. Defaults to the command line or URL.

url.description: URL of a Streamable HTTP MCP server (alternative to command/args)

name: baseline_server
